notes.title: ☪️ TSUNDERE MILFIN — Update 1.15 is live!
notes.notes:
https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2307220/extras/450hader.gif
🆕 Update 1.15 is now available in-game!

A fresh update has just been released for our beloved office sim — check it out now! 

Version 1.15 adds a brand new situation on the map that brings even more intrigue to your workdays. You’ll also find 2 fully animated scenes and 1 minigame waiting for you. 🔥 ːfuhrer_heartː

To access the new content, you’ll need the Strange Coin. 🪙
What happens if you use it? Who knows… but HR is already watching. 😳

Just one rule:
NO RUNNING ON THE STAIRS!
(Seriously. We’re running out of warning signs.) 💦

Thanks a lot for playing and sticking with us 💖

notes.title: UPDATE! New situation on the map!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619945/594cb8c985bb810dee757a91b0083c9654d95467.png

New small update is already available in the game! New situation on the map, fully animated art and gameplay improvements.


 New situation on the map is available! 4 levels, 1 minigame and 1 fully animated art. That's not all! The development of the game continues. This is just a small update. New situations are already in development.

 The JOB mode has also been updated, new levels for businesses have been added. It's great to see how many people have made such great progress on the leaderboard. You are awesome, thank you ♥


Your feedback is very important to us. Share your impressions and ideas for this and our other games.
